Title: Full Body – Beginner Fitness
Description:
Day 1 – Upper Body
- Lat Pulldown: 3 sets x 8-10 reps
- Bent Over Rows: 3 x 8-10 reps 
- Barbell Bench Press: 3 sets x 8-10 reps
- Dumbbell Shoulder Press: 3 x 8-10 reps 
- Bicep Curl with dumbbells: 3 x 8-10 reps 
- Triceps Pushdown: 3 x 8-10 reps

Day 2 – Lower Body
- Squats: 3 x 8-10
- Bodyweight Walking Lunges: 3 x 8-10 each leg
- Lying Leg Curls: 3 x 8-10
- Standing Calf Raises: 3 x 10
- Plank: 3 x 30 sec
- Crunches: 3 x 12-15 

Day 3 – Optional Cardio or Rest day
- For warm up: Burpees: 3 x 10
- 20 minutes of walking on the Treadmill
Or 20 minutes on the  Exercise bikes

Title: Muscle Sculpt – Intermediate Fitness
Description:
Day 1 – Chest & Triceps
- Bench Press: 4 x 6-8
- Incline Dumbbell Press: 4 x 8-10
- Cable Crossover: 4 x 10-12
- EZ-Bar Skullcrusher: 3 x 8-10
- Triceps Dips: 3 x 10-12

Day 2 – Back & Biceps
- Barbell Deadlift: 4 x 6
- Lat Pulldowns: 4 x 10-12
- Seated Cable Rows: 4 x 10-12- Dumbbell Curls: 3 x 8-10
- Hammer Curls: 3 x 10-12

Day 3 – Legs & Abs
- Squats: 4 x 6
- Romanian Deadlifts: 4 x 8-10
- Leg Extensions: 4 x 10-12
- Lying Leg Curls: 3 x 10-12
- Ab Roller: 3 x 12
- Hanging Leg Raises: 3 x 12

Title: Fat Blast HIIT – Fitness
Description:
4 Rounds for Time:
- 30 sec Jump Squats
- 20 Push-Ups
- 40 Mountain Climbers
- 20 Kettlebell Thrusters
- 60 sec Rest between rounds

Finish with 3 sets:
- Crunches: 20 reps
- Plank Hold: 60 sec

Title: Powerlifting Split – Strength
Description:
Day 1 – Squat Focus
- Back Squat: 5 x 5 @ 80%
- Front Squat: 3 x 5
- Walking Lunges: 3 x 12 each leg

Day 2 – Bench Focus
- Bench Press: 5 x 5 @ 80%
- Incline Press: 3 x 10
- Triceps Pushdown: 3 x 15

Day 3 – Deadlift Focus
- Deadlift: 5 x 5 @ 80%
- Barbell Rows: 3 x 10
- Plank: 3 x 45 sec
